  requires (len(A) == N)
  requires (len(B) == N)
  requires (N > 0)
  requires (H > 0)
  requires forall i in 0..N: ((A[i] > 0) and (B[i] > 0))
  requires forall i in 0..N: (A[i] <= B[i])
  ensures (result > 0)
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, [], []) == 0)
